_comment: Resolved absolute paths to every printing-press CLI this repo uses. NEVER depend on PATH: the installer bin dir is not on PATH, and START CO-PILOT.bat has a different PATH than a dev shell. Regenerate with: node cli/discover.js

yahoo-finance.note: PRIMARY. OHLCV for MNQ=F / MGC=F / ^VIX. Use chart only - quote list returns HTTP 401 (Yahoo closed /v7/finance/quote). Never use --interval 1d on continuous futures: gapped (385 daily bars over 7y for MNQ).

nse-india.note: India desk only (cli/india-desk/). Live commands work with no auth: market, movers, equity quote, index-driver. COOKIE-GATED: equity + index_constituents need a one-time `auth login --chrome` - until then sync reports resources:3 success:1 errored:2 and delivery-spike / delivery-divergence / sector-breadth / index-driver all stay cold (null or [] at EXIT 0). `sync --full` with no --resources syncs ONE resource (indices, 1 record) - always pass --resources explicitly. Store does NOT relocate via env; pass db:true to run()/runNdjson(). Must never reach a verdict or trade path - enforced by cli/test/india-firewall.test.js.

fred.note: Economic release calendar. Drives cli/econ-calendar.js, which FAILS CLOSED - no key means BLOCKED, never proceed. Only releases matching cli/econ-calendar.js RELEASES are turned into blackout windows.
fred.verified: 2026-09-06 (installed; calendar not yet exercised - no API key)

prediction-goat.note: INSTALLED BUT NOT USABLE FOR MACRO (verified 2026-09-06). Local index caps at 100 rows per resource: both keyset paginators (/markets/keyset, /events/keyset) return HTTP 422 invalid integer, and `markets list --limit 500` still returns 100. `sync` exits 0 anyway - the new default treats those failures as warnings. Result: topic fed|cpi|inflation|recession ALL return 0 hits, and `resolving --week` returns [] at exit 0 with no error. Also base_url is gamma-api.polymarket.com and every `trending` row is source:polymarket - the Kalshi half, where Fed/CPI markets actually live, returns nothing. `trending` DOES work and prices are genuinely live. Re-test after an upstream fix; do NOT wire into event risk until topic cpi returns hits.
prediction-goat.verified: 2026-09-06 (installed, synced, and found unusable for macro - see note)

notInstalled.kalshi: SKIP - full trading client, can place orders, needs RSA keys. Superseded by prediction-goat.
notInstalled.benzinga: BLOCKED - paid licence, two token families; the calendar needs the market/super-token.
